items.title: Cal Collins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 11, 1997
items.q: Yeah, he’s on. I don’t know his work that well.

ctx.x: Isn’t there one on the bill tonight? An Australian player? John Allred or something?
Yeah, he’s on. I don’t know his work that well. I know several of them, but I don’t think I know his work that well.
Well you may know better by the time the weekend’s—
